id: \rHave you ever seen a Fire and Poison type?
en: \rHave you ever seen a Fire and Poison type?
it: \rHai mai visto un Pokémon di tipo Fuoco e Veleno?

id: \rI really wish there was one. I don't know why there isn't a Fire-Poison type.
en: \rI really wish there was one. I don't know why there isn't a Fire-Poison type.
it: \rVorrei tanto che ce ne fosse uno. Non capisco perché non esista un tipo Fuoco-Veleno.

id: \bWhat is a Pokémon fan's favourite place to go in France?
en: \bWhat is a Pokémon fan's favourite place to go in France?
it: \bQual è il posto preferito in Francia di un fan dei Pokémon?

id: \bN: Your Pokémon... their voices are so pure. Are you not a Trainer?
en: \bN: Your Pokémon... their voices are so pure. Are you not a Trainer?
it: \bN: I tuoi Pokémon... le loro voci sono così pure. Non sei un Allenatore?

id: \bYou are. Why are your Pokémon so happy? Do you really see them as friends?
en: \bYou are. Why are your Pokémon so happy? Do you really see them as friends?
it: \bLo sei. Perché i tuoi Pokémon sono così felici? Li consideri davvero tuoi amici?

id: \bNo, it cannot be so simple, but you have given me a lot to think about.
en: \bNo, it cannot be so simple, but you have given me a lot to think about.
it: \bNo, non può essere così semplice, ma mi hai dato molto su cui riflettere.

id: \bSome villans tried turning my Haxorus against me.
en: \bSome villans tried turning my Haxorus against me.
it: \bDei malviventi hanno cercato di mettere il mio Haxorus contro di me.

id: \bThe nerve of some people. What if someone got hurt?
en: \bThe nerve of some people. What if someone got hurt?
it: \bChe faccia tosta, certa gente. E se qualcuno si fosse fatto male?

id: \rI'm so afraid. Will I do okay?
en: \rI'm so afraid. Will I do okay?

id: \bI'm a hiker, but I don't like caves.
en: \bI'm a hiker, but I don't like caves.
it: \bSono un Montanaro, ma le grotte non mi piacciono.

id: \bCall on me if you ever get burned.
en: \bCall on me if you ever get burned.
